description: Access-matrix invariants that do not hold yet (scripts/check-access.mjs, the access gate). Each entry is one app and invariant (<app>:<invariant>); the package named by fixedBy makes it hold and removes the entry, and an entry whose invariant holds fails the gate until it is removed.
